intro: CAVA Classic Lemonade (16 oz) delivers refreshing simplicity with freshly squeezed lemon juice, cane sugar, and water. This timeless beverage from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) offers a perfect balance of sweet and tart flavors. Whether paired with a hearty bowl or enjoyed on its own, this drink complements the [full CAVA menu](/). At $3.45 for 16 oz, it provides authentic lemonade taste without artificial ingredients.
priceCalories: The Classic Lemonade (16 oz) costs $3.45 and contains 260 calories. With 69g of carbohydrates from cane sugar and zero protein or fat, this beverage provides pure refreshment. The straightforward nutritional profile makes it easy to incorporate into your daily calorie tracking. For those wanting more, the 22 oz version offers 360 calories at $3.85, giving you size flexibility.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Classic Lemonade apart is its commitment to simple, quality ingredients. Made with freshly squeezed lemon juice rather than concentrates or artificial flavors, it delivers authentic citrus taste. The use of cane sugar instead of high-fructose corn syrup provides clean sweetness. This straightforward approach aligns with CAVA's Mediterranean-inspired philosophy of fresh, wholesome ingredients throughout their [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and beyond.
nutritionFacts: Each 16 oz Classic Lemonade contains 260 calories, all derived from 69g of carbohydrates. It has 0g protein and 0g fat, making it a pure carbohydrate beverage. The calorie content comes entirely from cane sugar and natural lemon sugars. Those monitoring sugar intake should consider this when planning meals from the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator). The drink contains no allergens beyond citrus.
whatsInside: CAVA Classic Lemonade contains just three ingredients: freshly squeezed lemon juice, cane sugar, and water. The fresh-squeezed citrus provides authentic lemon flavor and natural vitamin C. Cane sugar balances the tartness with clean sweetness without artificial sweeteners. Water brings everything together for optimal refreshment. This minimal ingredient list reflects CAVA's transparency, similar to their approach with [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) offerings.
tasteLike: The Classic Lemonade tastes bright, tangy, and refreshingly sweet. Fresh lemon juice delivers authentic citrus flavor with natural tartness, while cane sugar provides balanced sweetness that does not overpower. The result is a clean, crisp taste without artificial aftertaste. Each sip offers thirst-quenching refreshment with traditional lemonade flavor. The taste profile complements Mediterranean flavors found throughout CAVA's menu offerings perfectly.
customize: While the Classic Lemonade comes ready to enjoy, you can customize your experience by choosing between 16 oz and 22 oz sizes. Request extra ice for maximum chill on hot days. Some guests mix it with unsweetened iced tea for a lighter Arnold Palmer variation. Consider alternating sips between your lemonade and bites from [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) for flavor contrast.
pairsWell: Classic Lemonade pairs exceptionally well with savory Mediterranean dishes. It complements rich proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like grilled chicken or spicy lamb meatballs. The citrus cuts through creamy dips and dressings beautifully. Try it alongside falafel, hummus, or tzatziki for authentic flavor balance. The sweet-tart profile also refreshes your palate between bites of bold toppings and spicy harissa.
healthyChoice: Classic Lemonade offers refreshment with recognizable ingredients but contains significant sugar at 69g per 16 oz serving. For those monitoring carbohydrate or sugar intake, consider splitting the drink or choosing the smaller size. The absence of artificial ingredients, colors, and preservatives makes it cleaner than many commercial lemonades. Pair with protein-rich options for balanced nutrition. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary compatibility.
howToOrder: Order Classic Lemonade at any CAVA location by selecting it from the drinks menu. Choose your preferred size: 16 oz for $3.45 or 22 oz for $3.85. The lemonade comes ready to drink with ice. Available for dine-in, takeout, and delivery orders. Find your nearest restaurant through [CAVA Locations](/locations) to enjoy this refreshing beverage with your Mediterranean meal today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Blueberry Lavender Lemonade at 140 calories, Classic Lemonade contains more sugar at 260 calories per 16 oz. Cucumber Mint Lime offers a lighter option at 180 calories. The classic version provides traditional lemonade flavor without botanical additions. All three cost $3.45 for 16 oz, making price consistent. Choose classic for authentic lemon taste or explore flavored options for variety.
whoShouldTry: Classic Lemonade appeals to anyone seeking authentic, refreshing citrus beverages. Perfect for lemonade purists who prefer traditional flavors over trendy variations. Families appreciate its familiar taste that appeals to all ages. Those avoiding artificial ingredients benefit from its simple composition. Guests building Mediterranean meals want a beverage that complements rather than competes with bold flavors. Anyone dining at CAVA deserves this refreshing accompaniment.
worthTrying: CAVA Classic Lemonade earns its place as a menu staple with quality ingredients and authentic taste. At $3.45, it delivers fresh-squeezed lemon flavor without the artificial ingredients found in chain restaurant versions. The straightforward preparation honors traditional lemonade while meeting modern ingredient transparency standards. Whether cooling down spicy dishes or simply quenching thirst, this beverage provides reliable refreshment that enhances your CAVA dining experience.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Classic Lemonade (16 oz)?
faqs.a: CAVA Classic Lemonade (16 oz) contains 260 calories, all from 69g of carbohydrates. It has 0g protein and 0g fat. The 22 oz size contains 360 calories for those wanting a larger serving.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Classic Lemonade?
faqs.a: CAVA Classic Lemonade contains only three ingredients: freshly squeezed lemon juice, cane sugar, and water. No artificial flavors, colors, preservatives, or high-fructose corn syrup are used in this beverage.

faqs.q: How much does Classic Lemonade cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Classic Lemonade costs $3.45 for the 16 oz size and $3.85 for the 22 oz size at CAVA locations. Prices may vary slightly by location and are subject to change.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Classic Lemonade gluten-free and vegan?
faqs.a: Yes, CAVA Classic Lemonade is both gluten-free and vegan. It contains only lemon juice, cane sugar, and water with no animal products or gluten-containing ingredients. Check the allergen menu for citrus sensitivities.

faqs.q: What other lemonade flavors does CAVA offer?
faqs.a: Besides Classic Lemonade, CAVA offers Blueberry Lavender Lemonade (140 cal, 16 oz) and Cucumber Mint Lime Lemonade (180 cal, 16 oz). Both are available in 16 oz and 22 oz sizes for $3.45 and $3.85 respectively.
